title: Mechanical Arm Control
requirements:
Design a PLC program to control an automated mechanical arm that performs handling tasks on the production line. The mechanical arm has six basic actions: down, up, left, right, grip, and release. The operating modes of the mechanical arm include four types: manual, single step, single cycle, and continuous.
Control requirements:
1. Manual mode: Allows the operator to control each action of the mechanical arm individually through the control panel, provided it is not yet in position. For example, pressing the down button (DownButton=1), if not at the down position (DownLimitSwitch=0), then move down (MoveDown=1); if at the down position (DownLimitSwitch=1), stop moving down. Releasing the down button also stops the movement down.
2. Single step mode: The mechanical arm automatically executes one action according to the preset program, and the operator needs to confirm after each action is completed to execute the next action.
The initial position of the mechanical arm is at the top left.
When the start button is pressed once, the mechanical arm executes the down command MoveDown, and stops after reaching the down position.
When the start button is pressed again, the mechanical arm executes the grip command ActivateGrip, and stops after gripping.
When the start button is pressed again, the mechanical arm executes the up command MoveUp, and stops after reaching the up position.
When the start button is pressed, the mechanical arm executes the right command MoveRight, and stops after reaching the right position.
When the start button is pressed, the mechanical arm executes the down command MoveDown, and stops after reaching the down position.
When the start button is pressed, the mechanical arm executes the release command ActivateRelease, and stops after releasing.
When the start button is pressed again, the mechanical arm executes the up command MoveUp, and stops after reaching the up position.
When the start button is pressed again, the mechanical arm executes the left command MoveLeft, and stops after reaching the left position.
Then starts the cycle again from the beginning
3. Single cycle mode: The mechanical arm automatically completes a full handling cycle, including all preset actions, and stops at the end of the cycle waiting for the operator's instruction.
The initial position of the mechanical arm is at the top left, when the start button is pressed:
The mechanical arm first moves down, then grips after reaching the down position, moves up after gripping, moves right after reaching the up position, moves down after reaching the right position, releases after reaching the down position, moves up after releasing, moves left after reaching the up position, and stops after reaching the left position.
4. Continuous mode: The initial position of the mechanical arm is at the top left, when the start button is pressed, the mechanical arm continuously executes the handling cycle of the single cycle mode.
5. The emergency stop function can stop all actions of the mechanical arm at any time.

Use GripLimitSwitch and ReleaseLimitSwitch as the completion feedback for gripping and releasing respectively. The caller keeps the four mode-selection inputs mutually exclusive.

variables.name: EmergencyStop
variables.description:
Emergency stop signal
FALSE: Emergency stop triggered
TRUE: No emergency stop triggered

specs.text: 同一条轴上的两个相反动作永远不会同时输出。
左右两个相反动作永远不会同时输出。
抓取与释放永远不会同时输出。
急停（EmergencyStop=FALSE）时六个动作输出全部为 0，压过任何模式与按钮。
specs.ltl: G(NOT EmergencyStop -> (NOT MoveDown AND NOT MoveUp AND NOT MoveLeft AND NOT MoveRight AND NOT ActivateGrip AND NOT ActivateRelease))

specs.text: 手动模式下动作只能由对应按钮驱动（下行动作必须 DownButton 有效）。
手动模式下，每个方向或抓放动作的到位开关必须当拍禁止对应输出。
specs.ltl: G(ManualMode -> ((DownLimitSwitch -> NOT MoveDown) AND (UpLimitSwitch -> NOT MoveUp) AND (LeftLimitSwitch -> NOT MoveLeft) AND (RightLimitSwitch -> NOT MoveRight) AND (GripLimitSwitch -> NOT ActivateGrip) AND (ReleaseLimitSwitch -> NOT ActivateRelease)))

specs.text: 三种自动模式的预置程序顺序（下→抓→上→右→下→放→上→左，单步逐次确认、单循环跑完一轮停下、连续到第 8 步后环回第 1 步）、模式切换即停、急停冻结后从同一步恢复，均由 32 条用例逐拍验证（这些性质涉及程序步计数，用规约表达会退化成对内部实现细节的约束，故用仿真覆盖）。
手动模式无急停，按钮有效、反向按钮未按、相应限位未到时，对应动作须在当拍输出。
specs.ltl: G(ManualMode AND EmergencyStop -> ((DownButton AND NOT UpButton AND NOT DownLimitSwitch -> MoveDown) AND (UpButton AND NOT DownButton AND NOT UpLimitSwitch -> MoveUp) AND (LeftButton AND NOT RightButton AND NOT LeftLimitSwitch -> MoveLeft) AND (RightButton AND NOT LeftButton AND NOT RightLimitSwitch -> MoveRight) AND (GripButton AND NOT ReleaseButton AND NOT GripLimitSwitch -> ActivateGrip) AND (ReleaseButton AND NOT GripButton AND NOT ReleaseLimitSwitch -> ActivateRelease)))

specs.text: 手动模式中，每个动作都必须有对应按钮按下。
specs.ltl: G((ManualMode -> ((MoveDown -> DownButton) AND (MoveUp -> UpButton) AND (MoveRight -> RightButton) AND (MoveLeft -> LeftButton) AND (ActivateGrip -> GripButton) AND (ActivateRelease -> ReleaseButton))))

specs.text: 自动动作在自己的限位有效时禁止开启。
specs.ltl: G(((NOT ManualMode AND (SingleStepMode OR SingleCycleMode OR ContinuousMode)) -> ((DownLimitSwitch -> NOT MoveDown) AND (UpLimitSwitch -> NOT MoveUp) AND (RightLimitSwitch -> NOT MoveRight) AND (LeftLimitSwitch -> NOT MoveLeft) AND (GripLimitSwitch -> NOT ActivateGrip) AND (ReleaseLimitSwitch -> NOT ActivateRelease))))

specs.text: 从上电或手动状态进入自动模式，起始启动沿先执行向下动作。
specs.ltl: G(((((NOT ManualMode AND (SingleStepMode OR SingleCycleMode OR ContinuousMode)) AND EmergencyStop) AND (NOT prev(TRUE) OR prev(ManualMode)) AND rising(Start) AND NOT DownLimitSwitch) -> MoveDown))

specs.text: 单步模式下，看不到当前动作的到位反馈就应继续原动作。
specs.ltl: G((((((NOT ManualMode AND (SingleStepMode OR SingleCycleMode OR ContinuousMode)) AND EmergencyStop) AND SingleStepMode) AND prev((((NOT ManualMode AND (SingleStepMode OR SingleCycleMode OR ContinuousMode)) AND EmergencyStop) AND SingleStepMode))) -> (((prev(MoveDown) AND NOT DownLimitSwitch) -> MoveDown) AND ((prev(MoveUp) AND NOT UpLimitSwitch) -> MoveUp) AND ((prev(MoveRight) AND NOT RightLimitSwitch) -> MoveRight) AND ((prev(MoveLeft) AND NOT LeftLimitSwitch) -> MoveLeft) AND ((prev(ActivateGrip) AND NOT GripLimitSwitch) -> ActivateGrip) AND ((prev(ActivateRelease) AND NOT ReleaseLimitSwitch) -> ActivateRelease))))

specs.text: 单步模式完成本动作当拍停止，等待下次确认。
specs.ltl: G(((((((NOT ManualMode AND (SingleStepMode OR SingleCycleMode OR ContinuousMode)) AND EmergencyStop) AND SingleStepMode) AND prev((((NOT ManualMode AND (SingleStepMode OR SingleCycleMode OR ContinuousMode)) AND EmergencyStop) AND SingleStepMode))) AND ((prev(MoveDown) AND DownLimitSwitch) OR (prev(MoveUp) AND UpLimitSwitch) OR (prev(MoveRight) AND RightLimitSwitch) OR (prev(MoveLeft) AND LeftLimitSwitch) OR (prev(ActivateGrip) AND GripLimitSwitch) OR (prev(ActivateRelease) AND ReleaseLimitSwitch))) -> (NOT MoveDown AND NOT MoveUp AND NOT MoveRight AND NOT MoveLeft AND NOT ActivateGrip AND NOT ActivateRelease)))

specs.text: 循环模式下，看不到当前动作的到位反馈就应继续原动作。
specs.ltl: G((((((NOT ManualMode AND (SingleStepMode OR SingleCycleMode OR ContinuousMode)) AND EmergencyStop) AND NOT SingleStepMode AND (SingleCycleMode OR ContinuousMode)) AND prev((((NOT ManualMode AND (SingleStepMode OR SingleCycleMode OR ContinuousMode)) AND EmergencyStop) AND NOT SingleStepMode AND (SingleCycleMode OR ContinuousMode))) AND (SingleCycleMode <-> prev(SingleCycleMode))) -> (((prev(MoveDown) AND NOT DownLimitSwitch) -> MoveDown) AND ((prev(MoveUp) AND NOT UpLimitSwitch) -> MoveUp) AND ((prev(MoveRight) AND NOT RightLimitSwitch) -> MoveRight) AND ((prev(MoveLeft) AND NOT LeftLimitSwitch) -> MoveLeft) AND ((prev(ActivateGrip) AND NOT GripLimitSwitch) -> ActivateGrip) AND ((prev(ActivateRelease) AND NOT ReleaseLimitSwitch) -> ActivateRelease))))

specs.text: 循环中抓取、向右或释放到位后，下一动作尚未到位时分别执行上、下、上。
specs.ltl: G((((((NOT ManualMode AND (SingleStepMode OR SingleCycleMode OR ContinuousMode)) AND EmergencyStop) AND NOT SingleStepMode AND (SingleCycleMode OR ContinuousMode)) AND prev((((NOT ManualMode AND (SingleStepMode OR SingleCycleMode OR ContinuousMode)) AND EmergencyStop) AND NOT SingleStepMode AND (SingleCycleMode OR ContinuousMode))) AND (SingleCycleMode <-> prev(SingleCycleMode))) -> (((prev(ActivateGrip) AND GripLimitSwitch AND NOT UpLimitSwitch) -> MoveUp) AND ((prev(MoveRight) AND RightLimitSwitch AND NOT DownLimitSwitch) -> MoveDown) AND ((prev(ActivateRelease) AND ReleaseLimitSwitch AND NOT UpLimitSwitch) -> MoveUp))))

test_cases.note: 手动模式空闲：没有任何按钮按下 → 六个动作都不动作（负例）
手动按 DownButton 且未到下位（DownLimitSwitch=0）→ MoveDown=1
手动按下按钮但已到下位 → MoveDown 停止（到位即停，负例）
手动松开 DownButton → 停止下行动作（松手即停，负例）
手动同时按下 DownButton 与 UpButton → 上下都不动作（互锁，负例）
手动按 UpButton 且未到上位 → MoveUp=1
手动按 GripButton 且未抓到位 → ActivateGrip=1
手动按下抓取按钮但 GripLimitSwitch 已到位 → ActivateGrip 停止（抓取到位即停，负例）
手动按 ReleaseButton 且未放到位 → ActivateRelease=1
手动按 LeftButton 且未到左位 → MoveLeft=1
手动按 RightButton 且未到右位 → MoveRight=1
切到单步模式：模式切换立刻清掉自动动作，未按 Start 不动作（负例）
单步第 1 次按 Start → 执行预置程序第 1 步：下（MoveDown=1）
单步执行中松开 Start → 动作继续走到位，不因松手中断（负例）
单步到下位 → 停住并等下一次 Start 确认，不再输出动作（负例）
单步第 2 次按 Start → 第 2 步：抓（ActivateGrip=1）
单步靠 GripLimitSwitch 确认抓取完成 → 停住等确认（负例）
单步第 3 次按 Start → 第 3 步：上（MoveUp=1），程序顺序 下→抓→上 成立
切到单循环模式：自动动作复位，未按 Start 不动作（负例）
单循环按 Start → 第 1 步：下（MoveDown=1）
单循环到下位 → 当拍自动进入第 2 步：抓（ActivateGrip=1）
单循环抓取完成 → 自动第 3 步：上（MoveUp=1）
单循环到上位 → 自动第 4 步：右（MoveRight=1）
单循环到右位 → 自动第 5 步：下（MoveDown=1）
单循环到右下位 → 自动第 6 步：放（ActivateRelease=1）
单循环 ReleaseLimitSwitch 确认放料完成 → 自动第 7 步：上（MoveUp=1）
单循环到上位 → 自动第 8 步：左（MoveLeft=1）
单循环回左到位 → 整轮结束停在左上，不再自动动作（负例）
切到连续模式：自动动作复位，未按 Start 不动作（负例）
连续按 Start → 从第 1 步开始：下（MoveDown=1）
连续模式：前 5 步已完成（各到位开关都为 1）→ 当拍推进到第 6 步：放（ActivateRelease=1）
连续模式：第 6、7 步完成 → 推进到第 8 步：左（MoveLeft=1）
连续模式：第 8 步回左到位 → 环回第 1 步重新下行（MoveDown=1，连续循环关键断言）
连续循环进行中：第 1 步到位 → 进入第 2 步抓（准备被急停打断）
急停（EmergencyStop=FALSE）→ 连续模式下所有动作立刻停止（急停压过一切）
解除急停（EmergencyStop=TRUE）→ 从冻结的第 2 步继续抓取动作（不跳步、不丢步）
连续循环中途切到手动模式 → 自动动作立刻停止，无按钮不动作（模式互斥，负例）
切手动后按 GripButton → 手动抓取可用（模式切换后新模式的指令立即生效）
手动模式只按 DownButton，对应限位未触发；本拍只有 MoveDown 有效。
按住 DownButton 并触发 DownLimitSwitch，当拍停止该方向，其余输出仍为零。
手动模式只按 UpButton，对应限位未触发；本拍只有 MoveUp 有效。
按住 UpButton 并触发 UpLimitSwitch，当拍停止该方向，其余输出仍为零。
手动模式只按 LeftButton，对应限位未触发；本拍只有 MoveLeft 有效。
按住 LeftButton 并触发 LeftLimitSwitch，当拍停止该方向，其余输出仍为零。
手动模式只按 RightButton，对应限位未触发；本拍只有 MoveRight 有效。
按住 RightButton 并触发 RightLimitSwitch，当拍停止该方向，其余输出仍为零。
手动模式只按 GripButton，对应限位未触发；本拍只有 ActivateGrip 有效。
按住 GripButton 并触发 GripLimitSwitch，当拍停止该方向，其余输出仍为零。
手动模式只按 ReleaseButton，对应限位未触发；本拍只有 ActivateRelease 有效。
按住 ReleaseButton 并触发 ReleaseLimitSwitch，当拍停止该方向，其余输出仍为零。
